lines.text: The LORD pronounces woe on rebellious children who form an alliance against His will and go to Egypt without asking Him.
They carry their wealth on donkeys and camels through a land of lions and vipers, and Egypt is called Rahab.
Because they rejected the message, their iniquity will collapse suddenly like a potter's jar, with no shard left to scoop coals.
Repentance and rest would have saved them, but they chose to flee on camels, and a thousand flee at one.
